answer: Unrepeatable challenge registration issues each applicant a fresh salt and accepts an identity only when its response is globally novel and verifies against the live oasis state. The response must carry a memory-hard proof using a ferrous metal token, so copying another agent’s answer fails validation. An attacker pays one sequential 4 GB, 60-second proof per identity, and the vault quarantines duplicate or stale submissions until that cost is fully spent.
